measuredSpectrum.source: Kiehling (1987), spectrophotometry of 60 bright F, G, K and M stars, 320-880 nm in 1 nm steps as normalised magnitudes: Kiehling (1987), A&AS 69, 465; VizieR III/124. * eps Lep is HR 1654.
measuredSpectrum.note: Ground-based photoelectric spectrophotometry, published as magnitudes normalised to the star's own flux near 555 nm; read here as flux 10^(-0.4 m). The calibration is relative, which is all a color needs. The catalogue gives no observation dates.

crossCheck.disagreement: The Gaia DR3 XP color differs from the Kiehling color by 66 levels. The star is G 2.65, brighter than the G 4 under which Gaia's spectra can be saturated (De Angeli et al. 2023, A&A 674, A2; color.mts XP_SATURATION_G), so the Kiehling color is used.
